10d_1_volume_and_flux.png: Along one cell of the hidden direction, $z = 6Hx_0$ from 0 to $\pi$ (horizontal axis): the $z$-dependent part $|\cot z|(\sin^2 z)^{1/4}$ of the volume factor $\sqrt{|g|} = e^{-a_4}b_4^2|\cot z|(\sin^2 z)^{1/4}$ of the corrected metric (blue) and the $z$-dependent part $(\sin^2 z)^{1/4}$ of the boundary bracket $b_4^{3/2}(\sin^2 z)^{1/4}u^\dagger M_0v$ (orange); vertical axis: pure numbers. The volume vanishes at the fold $z = \pi/2$ (dotted line), where the two halves of the cell meet, and grows (integrably) towards $z = 0$ and $z = \pi$; the bracket vanishes at $z = 0$ and $z = \pi$ but is 1 at the fold, where it carries $b_4^{3/2}u^\dagger M_0v$, for example $2ib_4^{3/2}$ for the recorded column. The mode operator is symmetric, and the Krein charge conserved, only if a boundary condition removes this flux at the fold.
10d_2_symmetry_defect.png: For one concrete wave function $u(x_0)$ (16 entries of the form $\alpha + \beta\sin z + \delta\cos z$) at the instant $x_4 = 0$ of the history ($a_4 = 0$, $b_4 = 1$, so $c_g = 3/2$) and $m = H = 1$: the imaginary parts of the symmetry defect $\sqrt{|g|}\,(u^\dagger(h_0u) - (h_0u)^\dagger u)$ of the hidden-direction part $h_0 = A + D\partial_0$ of the curved good-sector mode operator (blue), of the derivative $\partial_0(w\,u^\dagger M_0u)$ (green dashed, on top of the blue curve), and of the defect of the operator without the spin-connection term $c_g$ (orange), against $z$ from 0 to the fold $\pi/2$ (horizontal axis). With the term the defect is exactly a derivative, whose integral is the flux at the ends; without it a remainder $-2c_g\sqrt{|g|}\,u^\dagger M_0u$ survives.
10d_3_frequency_paths.png: The 16 eigenvalues of the matrix $A = -im\gamma^{(x_4)} + ic_g\gamma^{(x_4)}\gamma^{(x_0)}$, which governs the good-sector waves that do not depend on $x_0$, in the complex plane (horizontal axis: real part, vertical axis: imaginary part, units of $H$) at the instant $x_4 = 0$ of the history ($a_4 = 0$, $b_4 = 1$, so $c_g = 3/2$; $H = 1$) for the mass $m$ from 0 to 5. For $m < c_g$ (orange) they are $\pm i\sqrt{c_g^2 - m^2}$ on the imaginary axis: these finite-norm waves grow. For $m > c_g$ (blue) they are real. Green circles: $\pm i\sqrt{5}/2$ at $m = H = 1$.
10d_4_growth_rate.png: The growth rate $\kappa = \sqrt{c_g^2 - m^2}$ of the instant (vertical axis, units of $H$; zero while $m \geq c_g$) of the good-sector waves that do not depend on $x_0$, along the prescribed history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ of the Revision record ($H = 1$), against the time $x_4$ (horizontal axis, units of $1/H$), for $m = 0.5$, 1, 2, 4. On this history $c_g = \frac{3}{2}e^{x_4/3}$ grows, so each curve leaves zero at the time $3\ln(2m/3)$ (dots) and then rises like $e^{x_4/3}$: every mass falls below $c_g$. The green dashed lines mark the five slices $a_{4,0} = 0$, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 of the Kohn-Sham record, where $c_g \geq 3/2 > 1$: without a boundary condition at the folds these waves grow at every slice for $m = 1$.
10d_5_krein_leak.png: The exact good-sector solution $\Psi = e^{a_4/2}b_4^{-1}(\cosh\theta + \sinh\theta\,K)\chi_0$ of mass 0, independent of $x_0$, with $\theta' = c_g$, along the history $a_4 = x_4$, $b_4 = e^{4x_4/3}$ ($H = 1$) from $x_4 = 0$ to 2, for a column $\chi_0$ with $B\chi_0 = \chi_0$; horizontal axes: the time $x_4$ in units of $1/H$. Left: the logarithm of its squared length (blue) lies on the formula $\ln(e^{a_4}b_4^{-2}\cosh 2\theta)$ (grey dashed); its slope keeps increasing because $c_g$ grows. Right: its Krein charge $Q = \int\sqrt{|g|}\,\Psi^\dagger B\Psi\,dx_0$ over the half $0 < z < \pi/2$ (orange) grows from $1/3$ to about 844; it equals its starting value plus the flux through the fold $z = \pi/2$ added up over time (green dashed). Without a boundary condition at the fold the Krein charge is not conserved.
